svg.text: Home electricity prices by state: change in one year
Average residential price, August 2026 vs. August 2025. Prices rose in 44 of 51 states (incl. D.C.).
Largest rises: HI +22.5%, ME +14.1%, NH +13.1% · Largest falls: CT −18.8%, CA −3.8%, UT −2.3%
Each tile: % change and current price in cents/kWh
Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Electric Power Monthly, Table 5.6.A (August 2026 preliminary). Chart: roofpayback.com
